text:
kevin: Planning to enable `batch_prefetch_v3` flag (caching + microbatch changes) in hosted runtime. Target rollout window 2026-03-18 13:00 UTC. Plan: canary 10% -> holdpoint -> 50% -> holdpoint -> full. Posting rollout guardrails & checks. Please ack and add any ops asks.

tara: Ack. Can you list drill failure criteria? Who's owning immediate rollback?

kevin: Rollback owner: @sre-oncall (first 30m) then eng-runtime oncall. Rollback criteria (if any triggered) -> immediate disable flag, route traffic to stable model variant. Thresholds:
- Request error rate increase > 0.5% absolute vs baseline
- p95 latency increase > 150 ms absolute OR > 15% relative
- Token cost per request doesn't improve by >10% (means no perf win)
- Prefetch cache hit drops below 75% OR eviction rate spikes > 10% over baseline
- Any user-reported 5xxs increase

jia: I'll run the synthetic traffic against canary nodes and post perf graphs. Linking perf job: https://perf/redwood/canary/job/482

sre-oncall: I will be monitoring p50/p95, error rate, and ASG CPU. Which dashboards should I watch?

kevin: Dashboards:
- Runtime -> batch_prefetch_v3 -> p50/p95 token latencies: https://console/redwood/d/runtime/bpv3
- Cost -> per-token cost by route
- Cache -> kv-prefetch hit/evict

oliver: Quick checklist for ops:
1) Ensure canary audience = low-rate customers + internal test API keys
2) Limit concurrency on canary pods to 50% of normal to reduce blast radius
3) Telemetry hook: add `x-canary-id` header so traces filterable

kevin: Flag toggle example to be used by deploy script:
```
POST /api/flags/toggle
authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN
{
  "flag": "batch_prefetch_v3",
  "percent": 10,
  "audience": "canary-lowrate,internal"
}
```

tara: Also please ensure feature gate `ff-prefetch-hysteresis` is ON (to avoid rapid toggles). Can we set a 5m cooldown?

kevin: Yes set cooldown=300s. Will schedule 10% at T, wait 15m, run smoke + perf, then 50% at T+40m. If all good, full at T+100m. If any metric exceeds thresholds -> immediate disable and revert rollout.

deploy-bot: Scheduled toggle: batch_prefetch_v3 -> 10% at 2026-03-18T13:00:00Z by kevin

sre-oncall: I'll be on watch for first 45m. Ping me in #paging if p95>threshold. Runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/prefetch-rollout

pm-anna: Noted. If we need to pause for customer-facing incidents, I'll coordinate comms.

oliver: LGTM from infra side. One ask: include at least one canary in eu-west for latency variance.

kevin: Added eu-west to audience. Thanks all. I'll start the job at 13:00 UTC and post updates here. :thumbsup:
